scope: controlled synthetic local transfer pilot, not original RouterBench comparison or production validation
alias_note: strong/weak indicate inherited router actions and model size, not verified local quality ordering
system: Responde preguntas sobre el material recibido. Devuelve solamente el dato o número solicitado, sin explicación ni formato adicional. Puedes calcular a partir de los datos. Si el dato no se puede obtener del material, responde exactamente NO_EVIDENCE.
quality_metric: strict normalized exact response on controlled synthetic tasks; not broad answer quality
generation_sampling: one cached response per case/model, shared across routing policies; no stochastic variance estimate
